meta.title: A well-formed but fake token is refused

direct.expectedResult: HTTP 422, plain text 'Invalid token'. The app sets no load_defaults and never enables authenticated encryption, so MessageEncryptor uses AES-256-CBC with a MessageVerifier; the verifier rejects the message (InvalidSignature, rescued). A 500 here would mean the cipher or the secret differs from that (InvalidMessage / nil encryptor are not rescued) — a defect too.
